entries.land_description: located in Show Low, AZ, four hours from Tucson and Phoenix). Maine and Arizona residents with 40 acres near Show Low, looking for womyn to create a land trust with. Long-term leasing is possible. Undeveloped land, privacy, dirt road, access to nearby lake. We're working the land in summers of '88 and '89. Well water coming soon. Building apprentices for 1989 are possible. To honor and nurture the land is a requisite.
entries.notes: We are/have: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, accessible, camping space, women working on the land.

entries.land_description: There are six of us involved with the ranch, four adults and one 12-year-old girl living here, and Helen (the owner) who lives in San Francisco. We have six acres of organic fruit and vegetables, several horses, cattle, chickens, and lots of pigs. This is a working ranch and we are very busy.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors (campers), new residents if workers, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs (if well-behaved)
entries.notes: Visitors must be prepared to camp and provide all their own necessities, as well as make a contribution. We are/have: 5 lesbians, 550 acres, housing/permanent structures, relatively accessible, plumbing, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: Small high-desert ranch, raising bees, horses, donkeys, emus, antique varieties of fruit trees, peabirds, guineas, and the usual assortment of dogs and cats. We build and sell beehives and other beekeeping supplies, raise queens and colonies, and have "bees for hire" (pollinators).
entries.welcomed_groups: occasional visitors, particularly those wanting to trade skills such as carpentry for beekeeping apprenticeships
entries.notes: Possible living arrangement available for proficient horsewoman who can teach either English or Western riding and start colts. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: (located at 1571 Woods Creek Rd). OWL Farm, part of the Oregon Women's Land Trust, has been in existence twelve years. We caretake 150 acres of beautiful, Goddess-protected earth, have an active mailing list of 450 QQ, and hold an annual lesbian gathering of Spirituality. We are Open Womon's Land, providing access to land for QQ who would not otherwise have means to do so. At present, we are two permanent residents with a four-year-old Q child.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs
entries.notes: We are/have: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farmland, camping space, women working and living on the land.

entries.land_description: On the slopes of the coastal mountain range, womon hold to the earth for safety, peace, solitude and community. The call of Ravens from the grandmother cedar, fir, madrone and oak soothes our souls as we work. To live with sky and clouds, seeing thousands of trees blowing in the wind heals our heart. We have sanctuary for elk, bear, bobcat, coyote, skunk, owl, hawk, vulture, and lesbian. Nature our best reflection, our soul dwells here.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, with an outreach to older women and women of color
entries.notes: We are/have: 6 lesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, accessible, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.street_address: c/o Jemma Crae, 6012 Coos Bay Wagon Rd
entries.land_description: Steppingwoods is 130 acres of wooded land 12 miles west of Roseburg. We (Jemma & JP) homesteaded land 13 years ago. We built two dwellings, various outbuildings and have two gardens, two dogs and one cat. Some selective logging is done periodically.
entries.notes: Camping is $3/person/night. No open fires. Local rural lesbian/gay activist community includes community center, 24-hour switchboard, cultural and spiritual events. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, accessible, electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: Rootworks is secluded "clean and sober" private land in the Southern Oregon Mountains, 5 miles from I-5. Quiet, peaceful. Gardens, orchard, stream. No phone. Limited solar electricity. Smoking in specified areas. One 62-year-old resident open to compatible residents and visitors. $5/day/person includes simple shared vegetarian meals. Three small cabins, extensive feminist library, easy hiking, outdoor waterbed.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Blatant Image and WomanSpirit were produced here. Energy for land appreciated. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, camping space, woman living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: A Lesbian collective and feminist retreat on forested land in southwest Oregon. Our 14th year. We have a main house with electricity, hot water, kitchen, and a shower. There are several women-built cabins for sleeping, and many secluded spots for camping.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl children, very young boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $2-10/day to our land support fund. We are currently seeking two new collective members. We are/have: 6 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, partly accessible, plumbing, (no septic, outdoor toilet), electricity, woods, large garden, camping space, women living and working on the land.
